title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ActionService
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ActionService. This class is a representation of an action function to a network that makes the function discoverable, registerable, remotely controllable by other devices in the network. Actions can be performed over classes that are characterised by an OBIS code. Subclass of saref:Service (core SAREF).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ActionService'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasOperation.description: Relationship (saref:hasOperation, core SAREF). Links this action service to the ActionOperation that carries out the actual exchange.
